data.long_meaning: Adriel (עַדְרִיאֵל) is a name of Hebrew origin meaning “Flock of God”. A theophoric compound of Hebrew עֵדֶר (ʿeder) 'flock' and אֵל (ʾel) 'God' - 'flock of God'. Its root is Hebrew עַדְרִיאֵל (ʿAdriʾel), from עֵדֶר (ʿeder) 'flock' + אֵל (ʾel) 'God'. Adriel is the anglicised form of Biblical Hebrew ʿAdriʾel.

seo.description_paragraph: Adriel (עַדְרִיאֵל) is a name of Hebrew origin meaning “Flock of God”. A theophoric compound of Hebrew עֵדֶר (ʿeder) 'flock' and אֵל (ʾel) 'God' - 'flock of God'. Its root is Hebrew עַדְרִיאֵל (ʿAdriʾel), from עֵדֶר (ʿeder) 'flock' + אֵל (ʾel) 'God'. Adriel is the anglicised form of Biblical Hebrew ʿAdriʾel.

faq.q: What does the name Adriel mean?
faq.a: Adriel means “Flock of God”.

faq.q: What is the origin of the name Adriel?
faq.a: Adriel is of Hebrew origin.

faq.q: What language does the name Adriel come from?
faq.a: Adriel is used in Biblical Hebrew, English, Greek, Latin.

faq.q: Is Adriel a boy's name or a girl's name?
faq.a: Adriel is used as a male name.

faq.q: How is Adriel pronounced?
faq.a: Adriel is pronounced AY-dree-əl.

faq.q: How is Adriel written in Hebrew?
faq.a: Adriel is written עַדְרִיאֵל in Hebrew script.

faq.q: How is Adriel written in Greek?
faq.a: Adriel is written Ἀδριήλ in Greek script.

faq.q: How is Adriel written in Latin?
faq.a: Adriel is written Adriel in Latin script.

faq.q: What is the linguistic root of Adriel?
faq.a: The root of Adriel is Hebrew עַדְרִיאֵל (ʿAdriʾel), from עֵדֶר (ʿeder) 'flock' + אֵל (ʾel) 'God'.

faq.q: What is the etymology of Adriel?
faq.a: A theophoric compound of Hebrew עֵדֶר (ʿeder) 'flock' and אֵל (ʾel) 'God' - 'flock of God'.

faq.q: Does Adriel appear in the Bible?
faq.a: Yes. The personal name occurs in the Hebrew Bible (1 Samuel 18:19; 2 Samuel 21:8).

faq.q: Is Adriel a Biblical name?
faq.a: Yes — the personal name occurs in the Biblical text. The personal name occurs in the Hebrew Bible (1 Samuel 18:19; 2 Samuel 21:8).

faq.q: Does Adriel occur in the Old Testament?
faq.a: Yes.

faq.q: Does Adriel occur in the New Testament?
faq.a: No — it is not attested in the New Testament.

faq.q: Is Adriel associated with a saint?
faq.a: No saint association is verified for the name Adriel.

faq.q: Is the meaning of Adriel verified?
faq.a: The meaning “Flock of God” is supported by Old Testament: son of Barzillai the Meholathite, husband of Merab, daughter of Saul (1 Samuel 18:19). Confidence: HIGH.

faq.q: What is the numerology or lucky number of Adriel?
faq.a: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Adriel total 49, reducing to 4. Number 4 is traditionally associated with stability, order and hard work. This is an interpretive tradition, not a factual claim.

faq.q: What are the common spelling variants of Adriel?
faq.a: Variants and alternative forms include Adri'el, Adriel.

faq.q: What is the transliteration of Adriel?
faq.a: Adriel is transliterated as ʿAdriʾel.

faq.q: How many syllables does Adriel have?
faq.a: Adriel has 2 syllables.

faq.q: What are the spiritual connotations of Adriel?
faq.a: Any spiritual significance attached to Adriel is interpretive. Its documented core is the lexical meaning “Flock of God”, and readings built on that meaning are presented as tradition rather than as religious doctrine.

faq.q: Where is the name Adriel used today?
faq.a: Adriel circulates chiefly in Biblical Hebrew, English, Greek, Latin naming communities. No verified registration statistics are published for it.
